fusions.name: Dropped Croak
fusions.desc: Throws a croak from the wrong place at one enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 8 damage and taking its next action away for 3 seconds. It is knocked back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Decoy Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a decoy that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to turn it against its allies for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Wrong Pocket
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Quick Study
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying an affliction, your damage rises by 12%.
